description:
Property Overview
This apartment spans a spacious 529 sq. ft. (49.14 sq. meters) and has been thoughtfully furnished, ready for immediate occupancy. Upon entering, you are greeted by beautiful wooden floors that extend throughout the entire property, creating a seamless and sophisticated aesthetic. The reception room provides a welcoming space for relaxing or working from home, benefiting from ample natural light.
The modern kitchen is well-equipped, offering everything needed for contemporary living. Both bedrooms are generously sized, providing comfortable retreats. The property boasts two well-appointed bathrooms, ensuring privacy and convenience for residents and guests alike. A significant advantage of this rental is that heating and hot water are included, simplifying your monthly outgoings and providing year-round comfort.
Location:
Porchester Gate enjoys an excellent selection of local amenities, with Queensway and Westbourne Grove offering a wide variety of shops, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants and independent boutiques. Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens are moments away, providing acres of green space for walking, running and leisure activities. The surrounding Bayswater and Notting Hill neighbourhoods offer a vibrant mix of dining, shopping and everyday conveniences, making this a particularly desirable Central London location.
Transport:
Porchester Gate is exceptionally well connected, with Queensway and Bayswater Underground stations just a short walk away, providing access to the Central, Circle and District lines. Paddington Station is also within easy reach, offering National Rail, Elizabeth line and Heathrow Express services for fast connections across London and to Heathrow Airport. Numerous bus routes operate along Bayswater Road and the surrounding streets, providing convenient links towards the West End, Notting Hill and other parts of Central London.
Please note that the photographs used in this listing are for illustrative purposes only and may depict AI Staging, or an earlier state of the property. Prospective tenants are strongly advised to view the property in person or request an up-to-date video before making any decisions.
